descFull: SparkWork is a local-first desktop Agent workbench for professional development and complex work. Orchestrate workflows, collaborate across Agent sessions, route tasks to the right models, and extend the workspace with custom tools and apps. Reviewable, steerable, reversible runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.
